steps.content: The mud monster is driven off. You see the flickering image of the white apparition again, a short distance away. It is walking toward the red moon in a daze, murmuring under its breath.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=30>It slowed down even before it entered the atmosphere. The speed before it started slowing down... reached the speed of light?! Could that explain why it had gone undetected? ...No, that's impossible. Maybe I should consider the whole thing in the framework of a wormhole? Or maybe I miscalculated...</size>

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=30>What about the mass? If my rough calculation isn't far off, then the element is... heavier than Element 118... A new element? It's been 22 years... considering the radioactive decay process... how is it possible that such extraterrestrial matter has caused so many disasters?</size>

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: <size=36>Quick... I need to act fast... Got to find it now...</size>
It is a woman's voice. It sounds familiar to you, although you can't quite put your finger on it. Dazed and confused, you take a step in her direction.
Special Effects (Earring)

As if coming out of a daze, she turns around to face you. She looks at you for a long while before recognition registers in her eyes. Her voice is gentle when she speaks to you, and her flickering figure begins to stabilize.
She looks familiar to you.
As you rack your brains, trying to remember where you have seen the face before, she reaches out a hand and, before you can do anything in response, touches something attached to your ear.
It's an earring.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: It's you...

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: What are you doing here? Are you lost too?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Just kidding. We'd be in a lot of trouble if even our guide got lost too.
She pauses, as if deep in thought.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Look likes I got separated from the rest of the team again. I was looking for the Perishing Star. Got to find it as soon as possible. Captain must be furious with me.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: I'm sorry. I'll return to the base now. Are you here to take me back, my dear guide?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know what this place is. I don't know the way back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know who you are.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Is that so... I guess we're both lost then.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Are you scared?

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Really? Good for you, our brave little guide. I wish I could be as brave as you are.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: Hehe... Quite understandable. You're barely an adult. But don't worry, I got your back.
She extends her hand to you, a warm smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: You are familiar with this place. You've found me, after all.

steps.speaker: Apparition
steps.content: And I'm sure you can find your way back.
She is still a blurry image, but you can feel the warmth in her smile, the only source of warmth in this unsettling place. You reach out your hand to take hers, as a question escapes your lips.
Her lips were moving, but you didn't catch the answer.
